visible_question: Reduce excessive neutral body brightness without worsening paired foreground/backing, text detail or original guards.
baseline: Current incident H1 D2, not rejected spline or modulation
model: Shared neutral_color_response, gain/bias tied across RGB and both references, no highlight lift. Applied to retained integrated finite lens color only.
composition: Preserve exact cached H1 integrated backing P0. P(g,b)=float32(P0 + alpha*(graded(M)-M)) on covered pixels; untouched elsewhere. This is the lens-color change before clear/foreground composition, with the original native rounding retained at identity. No target or foreground subtraction, no invented raw subrays. Clear cache unchanged.
dtypes: Stored M/P0/complete float32, alpha float64. Shared response output retained at its actual dtype; differences/addition in float64 then P cast float32. Material scored/stored float32; preclip raw retained.
fit: One finite active-set 2D convex quadratic solve, equal reference weighting, full original valid non-held training pixels excluding all actual foreground paint and zero physical coverage. No foreground approximation. At most interior plus six edge minimizers and identity: at most eight unique full candidate constraint/objective evaluations, hard cap16.
clip_constraints: Use global min/max over every contributing finite retained lens pixel in both references; gain positive. Impose g*min+b>=0 and g*max+b<=1 without tolerance.
stop: Identity or unsupported solve stops before trials. First original+completed+partial paired qualifier with visible tone/detail support stops. Otherwise four factors or deadline; no next fit or stage.
